abstract: A 10-year-old Japanese boy was admitted to our hospital with complaints of the sudden and severe chest pain having occurred when he caught a ball on his chest. A chest X-ray film and MRI made a diagnosis of cardiac tamponade caused by perforation into the pericardial sac of a mediastinal teratoma and pericardial drainage was carried out. Pericardial effusion showed cloudy yellow and CA 19-9 level in the effusion was 6, 538.2 U/ml. The tumor was extirpated after recovery of his general condition. The tumor was consisted of solid material (5 x 6 x 3 cm) and of cystic part (4 x 6 x 0.8 cm) involving of viscous yellowish fluid. Microscopic sections showed ulcer with bleeding, granulation and pancreatic tissue. Histopathological diagnosis was benign mature teratoma. Including this case, fourteen cases of mediastinal teratomas with cardiac tamponade have been reported and this is the youngest case. Pancreatic tissue were observed histopathologically in most cases and it was thought that autodigestion by digestive enzyme from pancreas was major cause of perforation of the tumor into the pericardial sac.
abstract_ja: 10歳の日本人男児が、胸にボールを受けた際に突然生じた激しい胸痛を主訴に入院した。胸部X線写真と磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)により、縦隔奇形腫が心膜嚢へ穿破したことによる心タンポナーデと診断され、心膜ドレナージが施行された。心膜液は黄色く混濁しており、液中のCA 19-9値は6,538.2 U/mlであった。全身状態の回復後に腫瘍を摘出した。腫瘍は充実部（5×6×3 cm）と、粘稠な黄色調の液体を含む嚢胞部（4×6×0.8 cm）からなっていた。顕微鏡検査では、出血を伴う潰瘍、肉芽組織および膵組織が認められた。病理組織学的診断は良性成熟奇形腫であった。本例を含め、心タンポナーデを合併した縦隔奇形腫は14例報告されており、本例は最年少である。ほとんどの症例で病理学的に膵組織が認められ、膵臓由来の消化酵素による自己消化が奇形腫の心膜嚢への穿破の主因と考えられている。
